turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My front door sticks every time it rains. I have to shove it with my shoulder.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The wood is probably swelling. You could tighten the hinges first or plane down the edge. Where would you like to start?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Jordan something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you book the cinema for Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet. I wasn't sure which film you wanted.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't mind. Anything but horror.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's that comedy everyone's talking about.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine by me. What time does it start?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's a seven o'clock and a nine thirty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seven, so we can eat after.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There you are. Any decision on the sticking door, hinges or planing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hinges first. That sounds a lot less scary.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan. Try swapping one top hinge screw for a longer one, that often pulls the door back into line.
